name: io.github.jiawei686/jev-ultrafast-mcp
title: jev-ultrafast-mcp
description: An MCP server that lets an AI agent hand browser work off instead of driving it click by click: browser_goal runs the loop server-side over an indexed table of the page's controls, and assertions rather than the model's opinion decide whether it worked. No Playwright, no Selenium, no screenshots in the loop.
